d: A migrant caravan moving through Mexico is facing resistance from Mexican authorities as people try to make their way north toward the United States. The journey has hit a roadblock, with security forces moving to stop the group's advance. The developments come amid renewed attention on border security and migration following the us midterm elections. For the migrants, the route north is becoming increasingly difficult, as they face enforcement actions and uncertainty over whether they will be allowed to continue towards the US border. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost…
